title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Creators and Course Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a creator turning an audience into an app: member-only content, video, subscriptions, fan push notifications, and an audience list you own.
body_markdown: Digital content sold inside the app generally uses in-app purchase, which Blink sets up through RevenueCat. Apple's guideline 3.1.3(a) has a separate path for reader apps covering video, audio, and books.
